summary: Natural Alternatives International (NAI) is an American nutritional supplement company based in San Marcos, California, that manufactures products such as Juice Plus. The note states the company was founded in 1980 by Mark A. LeDoux and had 241 employees in 2007. It also lists its manufacturing facilities in Vista, California, Switzerland and Japan.
